role: Defines the typed value union every fact resolver returns (FactValue), its structured absence reasons (MissingReason), per-fact availability metadata (Availability), human-readable renderers and the JSON tool_result envelope sent back to LLM providers.
types: MissingReason: enum (String, Codable) — 9 structured absence reasons (notRecorded, notYetComputed, outOfRange, sensorDropout, invalidParameter, internalError, tooMuchData, rateLimited, partialData)
Availability: struct — hasData / validRange / lastUpdated for schema-build gating; statics alwaysAvailable, unavailable, workouts(in:)
FactValue: enum — integer/double/string/date/durationSec/boolean/missing(reason,detail)/list/record with rendering and JSON envelope
AnyFactJSON: struct (private, Encodable) — wraps Foundation values for JSONEncoder with sortedKeys
toplevel: Static lets Availability.alwaysAvailable (hasData true, nil range) and Availability.unavailable (hasData false). FactValue and Availability are Sendable; MissingReason is Codable with raw string values used on the wire.

units.does: Builds Availability for workout-backed namespaces from the in-memory SessionArchive: unavailable when no entry has sessionType .workout, otherwise hasData true with validRange earliest...latest workout date and lastUpdated = latest.

branches.cond: there is at least one workout date
branches.effect: false: returns .unavailable; true: Availability(hasData: true, validRange: earliest...latest, lastUpdated: latest)

units.does: Formats a Double for display: integral values as '%.0f', otherwise '%.2f' with a regex stripping an optional decimal point and trailing zeros (5.20 -> '5.2', 5.00x -> '5').

branches.effect: true: String(format: "%.0f"); false: two-decimal string with trailing zeros/point removed by regex \.?0+$

units.does: Single-line human rendering of a FactValue: numbers via trimmed/plain, string raw, date as local ISO 8601, duration via formatDuration, bool yes/no, missing as 'unknown (reason[: detail])', list bracketed comma-joined, record as {k: v} with keys sorted.

branches.effect: renders unknown (reason) with detail appended when present

units.does: Multi-line indented rendering: records become sorted 'key: value' lines (nested lists/records indented a level deeper, trailing whitespace trimmed), lists become '- item' lines or '(empty)', scalars pad + humanReadable. Only exercised by FactValueTests.

branches.effect: joins pad+key+': '+nestedRendering lines, strips trailing whitespace, returns
removes trailing whitespace/newlines one by one
true: returns pad+'(empty)'; false: maps items
scalar: inline humanReadable; non-scalar: newline + prettyMultiline(indent+1)

units.does: Renders one record field value for prettyMultiline: nested record/list drops to an indented block wrapped in newlines; scalars inline followed by newline.
True unless the value is a .record or .list.
True when the value is .missing.

units.key: func FactValue.from(_: Int?, reason: MissingReason, detail: String?)
units.does: Convenience builder: wraps a non-nil Int? as .integer(value), otherwise returns .missing(reason: reason [default .notRecorded], detail: detail).

branches.effect: value non-nil -> .integer(value); nil -> .missing(reason:detail:) with caller's reason (default .notRecorded)

units.does: Encodes envelope() through JSONEncoder (.sortedKeys) via AnyFactJSON to a UTF-8 JSON string — the tool_result content for every provider (toToolResultJSON returns the same); falls back to '{"value":null,"missingReason":"internalError","detail":"FactValue not JSON-serialisable"}' when encoding or UTF-8 decoding fails.

branches.cond: encode succeeded and data decodes as UTF-8
branches.effect: true: returns the JSON string; false: returns the internalError envelope literal (attempt() logs the thrown error)

units.does: Returns toolResultJSON: the same envelope bytes for the Apple Foundation tool path, from the one encoder.
Builds the wire envelope dictionary: asOf = localISO8601(now), confidence = 'high', and either value = NSNull + missingReason (+detail) for .missing, or value = toAnyJSON() otherwise.

branches.effect: sets value NSNull and missingReason rawValue

units.does: Recursively converts the FactValue tree into Foundation JSON types: Int, Double (non-finite -> NSNull), String, ISO date string, duration seconds Int, Bool, nested missing -> full envelope dict, list -> [Any], record -> [String: Any].

branches.effect: returns d, or NSNull when not finite
returns envelope() (nested envelope with its own asOf/confidence)

units.does: Formats a Date as ISO 8601 with colon-separated current local UTC offset (e.g. 2026-04-21T19:30:00-07:00) using a fresh Date.ISO8601FormatStyle each call.
Formats seconds as 'Hh Mm Ss' when >= 1h, 'Mm SSs' when >= 1 min, else 'Ss'.
Stores the wrapped Foundation value.
Encodable witness: encodes the wrapped value as String/Bool/Int/Double/array/dict (recursively wrapping), NSNull or any other type as JSON null.
units.entry: Encodable.encode(to:) witness invoked by JSONEncoder from toolResultJSON

branches.effect: encode dict of AnyFactJSON (sortedKeys from encoder)
encodeNil — silently emits null for any unhandled type
